_meta.purpose: footprint patch for the 38 store-object-reading operators not covered by p1_kernel_footprints.json; consumed by p1_factor_dag.column_plan() for column pruning and cache-invalidation fingerprints

conventions.footprint: store-mediated reads only (store.get / store.load_raw). For store.get entries, 'columns' lists ONLY the value variable(s) — join keys (permno/time_avail_m/time_d/gvkey/tickerIBES) are added automatically downstream. For store.load_raw entries, 'columns' lists EVERY column the code subsequently touches, including filter/merge/assign keys.
conventions.direct_files: file reads that bypass the DatasetStore (pyarrow/pandas read_parquet, bucket streaming). Exempt from store column-pruning; needed for cache-invalidation fingerprints. Paths are relative to Factor_Construction/. 'Data/daily_buckets' denotes the whole bucket=0..63 partitioned directory; iter_buckets always reads permno and time_d in addition to the listed value columns.
conventions.helper_caches: reads made via helpers (_universe_masks -> _derived_cache['universe_masks'], _crsp_rows_mask -> 'crsp_rows_mask', _compustat_rows_mask -> 'm_aCompustat_rows_mask', smt_gvkey mask -> 'smt_gvkey_rows_mask', _get_derived_cache keys 'price_delay_long'/'ff3_idio_long') are attributed to every calling op even though only the first caller per store instance physically loads the file.
conventions.path_note: the store's data_dir default is Open_Source_Asset_Pricing/Signals/pyData/Intermediate — direct_files entries under that directory touch the SAME physical files as the store datasets of the same name, just not through the store object.

shim_spot_check.procedure: monkeypatched DatasetStore.load_raw/get to log (dataset, variable) while inside the wrapped OPERATOR_REGISTRY entry; fresh DatasetStore per factor; evaluated each factor via ExpressionEvaluator on build_output_template()
shim_spot_check.result: logged datasets matched the static audit exactly for all five ops; zero discrepancies. FirmAge (require_compustat_row=False) logged monthlyCRSP only, confirming m_aCompustat is conditional on the param.
